notes: Sixteen points, no elevation: a ~20 m forward hop followed by a ~1 m out-and-back jitter (never clearing the 5 m threshold), repeated 5 times. The raw haversine sum over every consecutive pair is ~110.083 m (see DERIVATION.md); the reported distance is the smoothed accumulator, ~100.075 m, which only advances the anchor on a hop that clears the threshold. The corpus asserts the smoothed value because that is what GPX.getTotals() reports as `distance` (gpx.ts:148); the raw per-point running total is not part of the public contract (D-04, the raw index-aligned array is not ported).
